summary: ConnectWise's Cloud Backup compromise is now a confirmed supply-chain attack spanning 173 tenants with backup services halted, while an ETS breach exposed records of 7 million California students and Drupal warned of imminent RCE exploits. A 12-CVE WordPress critical wave, an evolved MALFEX npm loader, a TeamCity RCE cluster, a Rhysida county breach, AI log-filter bypass research, and a 45-device AdFection count round out the day.
